summary: Arbe Robotics filed a Form 6-K reporting that its 2026 annual general meeting, originally set for September 2, 2026, was adjourned to September 9, 2026 for lack of quorum and then convened. Shareholders reelected Prof. Yonina Eldar and Dr. Boaz Schwartz as Class II directors until 2029 and approved CEO Ram Machness's and President Kobi Marenko's employment terms, executive and non-executive equity awards, an amended compensation policy, KPMG reappointment, and a reverse-split authorization targeting roughly $3.00 per share. No special-situation transaction is present; the event is a routine AGM outcome, so no deal terms are stated.
